concept.hr: Zadani put hvata sve što ništa specifičnije ne hvata; petlju zaustavlja TTL
concept.en: The default route catches what nothing more specific does; TTL ends a loop

summary.hr: Dodaj statičke i zadane putove na tri usmjernika i pošalji ping: odgovor treba put natrag, /24 pobjeđuje /0, a krivi zadani put vrti petlju do isteka TTL-a.
summary.en: Add static and default routes on three routers and ping: the reply needs its own way back, /24 beats /0, and a wrong default route loops until the TTL runs out.
